title: T204 · IFRS 9 Credit Migration Matrix Generator
description: Generate cohort transition matrices across credit rating bands for IFRS 9 ECL modelling. Embedded benchmark matrices by asset class. Calculate Stage 1/2/3 migration probabilities, lifetime PD curves, macro overlay, and ECL stage allocation. Client-side. Zero PII.
